title: Development, Validation and AI Chatbot Evaluation of the Adolescent Mental Health AI Response Tool
summary_en: The authors developed and validated a clinician-informed tool for auditing AI chatbot responses to adolescent mental health disclosures and used it to compare four major chatbots, finding better coverage of guideline-informed content for anxiety than depression and for moderate than severe presentations.
title_cn: Development, Validation and AI Chatbot Evaluation of the Adolescent Mental Health AI Response Tool
